comment: mak's manual fact rulings (2026-10-01 batch review). Applied by mergeVerification.mjs AFTER the log and search passes, so they survive re-verification. A ruling pins the verdict/confidence shown on the review page and, when `proposed` is present, exactly what publishes on approval. Conflicting archive/announcement dates are settled here per event, never by a global one-day shift. A ruling may also pin `events` ([{date, status: agreed|signed|processed}]): the move's distinct dated events, stored side by side; `proposed.date` stays the one the page prints.
